newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens weaker, depressed by Dow losses.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens weaker, depressed by Dow losses.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started the last session of the week lower, after the Dow reversed gains seen at London's close to end down, dealers said.

The index was 7.8 points off at 4,650.1 by 0738 GMT, hit also by an article in the Financial Times suggesting a windfall tax on utilities would be a hefty five billion stg and that the Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown is resisting pressure to scrap the abolition of a corporate tax (ACT) break on dividends in next Wednesday's Budget.
"Brown seems to be trying to warn the market about the Budget and it's ignoring him," said a dealer.
